up: Get all activity records from the activities table where the associated assay has chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1614234', and where the activity is an exact measurement (standard_relation = '=' and standard_value is not null). For each such record, include the compound identifier (chembl_id from molecule_dictionary), the canonical SMILES from compound_structures, and the activity details: standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
sql:
SELECT
  md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  a.standard_type,
  a.standard_relation,
  a.standard_value,
  a.standard_units
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1614234'
  AND a.standard_relation = '='
  AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL;
